dedupe_keys.name: average monthly air temperature of the city of luxembourg 2017 derived from urbclim

description: The FAIRiCUBE project deposits monthly mean near-surface air temperature for Luxembourg City in 2017. The public file is a 12-band, 10-metre GeoTIFF derived from UrbClim climate variables for European cities, and Zenodo labels this copy CC BY 4.0. Month-specific urban temperature can drive building cooling-load simulations or compare heat exposure around public space and water assets. It is model-derived weather context, not a thermometer network, and one year does not establish future climate conditions. The landing page does not state the temperature unit, aggregation method from UrbClim or independent validation. The upstream UrbClim and ECMWF terms need separate review if model inputs are redistributed. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this city extraction. The TIFF was not downloaded, so twelve-band order, cell projection and value ranges were not checked.
name: Average Monthly Air Temperature of the City of Luxembourg 2017 derived from UrbClim
